skill.description: Use this skill to build responsive HTML email from approved copy and QA rendering across Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, iOS, and Android.
skill.summary: Build responsive email HTML and render QA reports.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from markdown links, metadata URLs, client names, and inline documentation. One confirmed medium-risk item remains: a documented Resend render-test command can perform live networked email sending. No prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or malicious business logic was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Live render-test command can send email through Resend.
remediation.suggestion: Keep dry-run as the default, require explicit user confirmation for --live, restrict recipients to owned test inboxes, and document credential handling.

content.value_statement: Email teams need HTML that survives client quirks, dark mode, image blocking, and mobile screens. This skill turns approved creative into a render-ready build with QA notes.
actual_capabilities: Converts approved email creative into responsive, table-based HTML.
Checks dark-mode contrast, accessibility basics, and mobile readability.
Builds a client-render matrix for Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, iOS, and Android.
Specifies image-off fallbacks and bulletproof CTA buttons.
Creates or checks a plain-text alternate for message and link parity.
limitations: It does not write subject lines, body copy, or campaign strategy.
It does not compute SEND scores, vetoes, or EQS ratings.
Measured render results require a seed test, inbox preview, or user-supplied render evidence.
Paid render-preview services are optional and are not included with the skill.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Campaign Build
use_cases.description: Turn approved campaign copy into responsive email HTML with a plain-text version and QA notes.

use_cases.title: Fix Client Rendering Issues
use_cases.description: Diagnose Outlook, Gmail, dark-mode, image-off, and mobile layout defects in an existing email.

use_cases.title: Document Render Readiness
use_cases.description: Create a client-render matrix that separates measured test results from estimated support guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Build From Approved Creative
prompt_templates.prompt: Build responsive email HTML from this approved creative. Include the HTML build, plain-text alternate, and render QA notes for standard clients: [paste creative].

prompt_templates.title: QA Existing Email HTML
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of an existing build
prompt_templates.prompt: QA this email HTML across Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, iOS, and Android. Flag dark-mode, image-off, accessibility, and mobile issues: [paste HTML].

prompt_templates.title: Repair Rendering Defects
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced fix request with known failures
prompt_templates.prompt: This email breaks in Outlook and image-off mode. Fix the layout, preserve the approved copy, and explain each render change: [paste HTML].

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Render Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a render handoff for this email using these seed-test results. Label each client row as Measured or Estimated: [paste HTML and results].

output_examples.input: Approved promotional copy, CTA URL, brand colors, and no existing HTML.
output_examples.output: A responsive single-column email build, matching plain-text version, and QA summary covering dark mode, accessibility, image-off behavior, and client estimates.

output_examples.input: Existing email HTML that fails in Outlook and loses its CTA when images are blocked.
output_examples.output: A repaired build plan with bulletproof CTA guidance, Outlook-safe layout notes, and a defect summary for unresolved copy constraints.

output_examples.input: Seed-test screenshots and target clients for a newsletter build.
output_examples.output: A render matrix that marks tested clients as Measured, untargeted clients as Estimated, and unknown behavior as open loops.

best_practices: Provide approved copy, destination URLs, brand colors, and target clients before requesting a build.
Run seed or inbox-preview tests when measured client-render claims are required.
Keep copy changes separate from render fixes so approvals remain clear.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to invent campaign copy or change approved wording silently.
Do not treat estimated client support guidance as measured render evidence.
Do not place core offers, claims, or CTA text only inside images.

faq.question: Does this skill write email copy?
faq.answer: No. It builds and QA checks HTML from approved copy or existing HTML.

faq.question: Can it test real inbox rendering?
faq.answer: It can use user-supplied seed-test or inbox-preview evidence. Without that evidence, render rows stay Estimated.

faq.question: Which email clients does it cover by default?
faq.answer: It covers Gmail, Outlook desktop and web, Apple Mail, iOS Mail, and Android mail clients.

faq.question: Does it support dark mode?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks color contrast, forced inversion risks, logo visibility, and dark-mode-safe container colors.

faq.question: What output should I expect?
faq.answer: Expect a responsive email build, plain-text parity check, client-render matrix, and render QA report.

faq.question: Can it score email quality?
faq.answer: No. It prepares the rendered unit for a separate email quality auditor.
